import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    best_dif = float('inf')
    best_a = 0
    best_b = 0
    for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
        a1 = math.ceil(b * x / y)
        a2 = math.floor(b * x / y)
        # Check a2/b
        dif = abs(x / y - a2 / b)
        if dif < best_dif:
            best_dif = dif
            best_a = a2
            best_b = b
        # Check a1/b
        dif = abs(x / y - a1 / b)
        if dif < best_dif:
            best_dif = dif
            best_a = a1
            best_b = b
    print(f"{int(best_a)}/{int(best_b)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
